05 / GOOD TO KNOW

The practical bits.

How do I place an order?

Add your favourites to your basket, include your preferences, then copy your request and share it with Sunita on Instagram. Sunita will confirm the price, availability, delivery, and payment details before your order is final.

Can I choose a different colour or design?

Tell Sunita what you have in mind using the custom request option. She’ll let you know what’s possible and confirm the details with you.

How long will my piece take?

Making time depends on the design and current requests. Please mention your occasion or preferred date so Sunita can confirm whether it can be ready in time.

What about delivery and payment?

Delivery options, charges, and payment arrangements are confirmed directly with Sunita before you place your order.
